reviews.x: These were adorable.  These were purchased for the grandson's 2nd birthday bash.  The children were just so cute.  We had the mouseketeer club.  If anyone is wanting to have a mickey party these are a great party favor.  It is something the little children will be able to play with repeatedly.  The little children usually do alot of play acting or ours do.  The minnie ears were adorable and the girls will get alot of fun times with these.  The ears are made extremely well and will give the child

These are nice quality, the kids love them.  Send one home with each kid and they will feel like they got a grab bag full of stuff.  I would buy these again. They fit good and there were no complaints that they were too tight or anything.

reviews.t: These were great for a kid's birthday party however
reviews.x: These were great for a kid's birthday party however, the Minnie Mouse ears were different from the Mickey Mouse ones. The Minnie Mouse ears themselves felt rougher and were sparkly unlike the Mickey Mouse ears which felt of a softer material. Also, since they are big, they would tend to slide down. Overall they looked good and arrived quickly. The product itself was cute and lots of fun for the guests. I would recommend this product!

I purchased these for my 3 year old’s Minnie Mouse birthday party. They were great favors and all of the kids were so excited. I was surprised that they were actually pretty sturdy. If you’re expecting quality of something from Disneyland, then that’s a bit unrealistic, but they were absolutely perfect for the kiddos. Would definitely purchase them again and the girls loved the sparkly ones.

I absolutely love these!  They are cheap and exceeded my expectations!! I can't wait for my daughters party to use them!! I highly recommend these! The ears shipped much faster than I expected. I figured it would be a few weeks for them to arrive and they got here within a week and a half!!!

reviews.t: only Minnie Mouse ears that look nothing like the image in the advertisement
reviews.x: I ordered these and what I received were 12 Minnie Mouse headbands with polka dot bows. They were not sequined and no Mickey Mouse ears were included as the product description says...only Minnie Mouse ears that look nothing like the image in the advertisement.

reviews.t: It was a huge hit and the kids loved them! I'm just glad we had enough of ...
reviews.x: We used these at our daughters first birthday party for all the other kids to wear around. It was a huge hit and the kids loved them! I'm just glad we had enough of them. If your have a Mickey or Minnie Mouse themed birthday party I would highly recommend.

I originally bought these for the kids to wear at my daughter's 2 year old party, but it was so many kids so I chose to give them to the adults. The adults loved the ears so much. We enjoyed wearing our ears..it was a grown folks party too. lol!

reviews.t: Nice and simple, got the desired effect
reviews.x: These were absolutely perfect for my daughter's 2nd birthday party. All the kids loved them and even some adults wanted to wear them. I placed them hanging off the side of each goody bag and it added that much cuteness to it.
1/2 my order the ears are falling off. I’ll have to hot glue the ears on for a party this weekend. I’m just glad I checked them before the party. And a few of them had the sequence missing
Definitely not true Minnie/Mickie ear size. These are small and not very good quality. They have a flimsy feel and appearance.
Great Package! It was perfect for my daughters 2nd birthday
Half of the ear headbands were broken into pieces!

reviews.t: ... the purpose of what you are paying these are great for kids parties etc
reviews.x: For the purpose of what you are paying these are great for kids parties etc. I bought these to use as a base for making my own minnie ears, but I didn't get around to it. Taking a toddler to Disney these were great since she won't wear them long we didn't want to get really expensive ones and since she is a toddler if she misplaced these we had several other pairs and didn't need to worry about losing any!

I purchased these for a recent trip to Disney for five adults. The ears fit well on most of the adults' heads. The day we wore these was somewhat windy and I felt as though I may lose them off my head a few times. However, someone else wore them down Splash Mountain and they stayed put :-) These are a great alternative to the expensive ears sold in the parks.

Purchased for a Mickey/Minnie Mouse themed party. Asked people to bring their ears, but in case someone forgot wanted to have some on hand to ensure kids (and adults) didn't feel left out. They fit adults and kids alike and people even commented on the quality and indicated how well made they were for the price. Everyone was happy! :)

Very good deal for price!!!  Good quality - very comfy to wear on your head.  Light weight!  As an adult I could wear these perfectly - but so could my children!  Much better deal than you will find at WDW!  You can buy all 12 pairs cheaper than you can get one pair in the park.  Seems well constructed!

The ears were perfect. The kids (and adults) love them. My children (ages 1 and 3) were able to wear them for hours during the party. I tried them on and they didn't hurt like some headbands. The ears stayed up the entire time. They are still playing with them. They were great for party favors.

We actually love these they aren't as cheap and thin as most they are sparkly and even a little fuzzy and everyone seems to love them plus they don't hurt sitting on your head for to long like a lot of other headbands, deft perfect for our Minnie mouse birthday party !!

We bought these for a toddler birthday party.  They are not the most high quality ears that you will find but the for the price and the number of ears that you receive they are worth it.  I'm happy with the purchase as they added another layer of whimsy to our party.

SO disappointed, All I got were plain mickey ears and none of them were sparkly or had bows. Came right before day of Party so nothing I can do now. Not even time for me to run out and add bows myself. Too bad, The quality isn't terrible but this is a Minnie party.

Great quality and super cute! We used them for my son's first birthday party which was a Mickey Mouse Clubhouse theme. The other little kids loved wearing them too. They also shipped pretty quickly. They got here a lot sooner than I thought which was great!!

LOVE THESE. I bought these for my daughters birthday party and they were a great hit. All the stores I looked at only sold them by 1 for a really high price so I took a chance on these. I had no idea that they were going to be made as well as they were!

I used these at my toddler's birthday party and everyone adored them! They wore them during the party and took them home as a party favor! Great quality! The mickey ears were soft felt-like and the Minnie ears were sequenced ears. So cute!

These were a great value for the price! We used them as party favors for our daughter's Minnie-themed birthday party, and loved how affordable they were! Much better than $3 each as I found at other places. The kids all looked so cute!

claims.text: Many reviewers say the kids loved these ears and they were a hit at Mickey/Minnie themed birthday parties.
Several reviewers note the ears are good quality and sturdy for the price, though some find them flimsy or of lesser quality.
A number of reviewers report durability problems, including broken ears, ears falling off, and missing sequins.
Some reviewers mention the ears fit adults as well as kids, though a few note they can slide down or feel loose.
A few reviewers complain that the received product differed from the description, such as only Minnie ears or non-sequined bows.
